definitions: What someone does is more important and shows their true intentions and feelings more clearly than what they say.
Deeds are a more accurate reflection of character and commitment than mere talk.
examples: Don't just tell me you'll help, show me; actions speak louder than words.
He promised to change, but actions speak louder than words, and he's still doing the same things.
The company's commitment to sustainability was evident; actions speak louder than words, and their new policies proved it.
synonyms: put your money where your mouth is
